Agent.comment: FROZEN (verbatim from choreograph agent-ontology.ts). Stable, config-derived identity (model + system-prompt hash). The memory-WITNESS: OWNS a perspective membrane (a named graph) and its facts are attributed, timestamped, defeasible testimony. Dual-typed prov:Agent + agt:Witness. agt:agentId is THE witness key: identical to observer_agent_id and the mem:observedBy leaf and the membrane segment (spec §4 identity unification, LANDED on choreograph main so the agt:Agent subject IRI urn:sophia:agent:{agentId} byte-matches L0's observer_iri).

agt:agentId.source: stable content-addressed id agent-<hex16>; THE witness key; equals observer_agent_id (spec §4)

rdfs:label.source: mutable display annotation only; NEVER an identity input (spec §4)

agt:voicing.source: exactly one of agt:Monovocal | agt:Parliament (I3); object property into the agt:Voicing enum

agt:ownsMembrane.source: the …:projection:memory:agent:{id} named graph this agent OWNS; Voices have NO such predicate (the single hinge of secession, spec §5.5)

agt:hasVoice.source: inverseOf agt:voiceOf; Agent -> its internal agt:Voice(s)

Agent.subject_rule: urn:sophia:agent:{agentId} - the unified witness IRI (spec §4; byte-matches L0 observer_iri)

Session.comment: One conversational session owned by an agent + a user. For workflow-derived sessions, agt:realizedBy is the inverse reading of wf:Run wf:boundToAgent agt:Session.

agt:model.source: the inference model the session pins (session-level attribute)

Turn.comment: One journal entry as metadata + tool-usage pointers ONLY - never the message body. recallRef/songRef are RESERVED opaque seams into the Memory/Song faculties (emitted only if a caller injects them). For workflow-derived turns, agt:realizedBy is the inverse reading of wf:AgentRun wf:boundToAgent agt:Turn.

agt:inRun.source: §WS1 RELEVEL - the agt:Run this turn nests under (projection.ts:786)

agt:recallRef.source: reserved opaque IRI pointer INTO the Memory faculty (S5 fold emits only if injected)

agt:songRef.source: reserved opaque IRI pointer INTO the Song faculty

agt:drivenBy.source: Turn -> the agt:Driver who steered it; OPTIONAL, at most one in v1 (range left open to multiplicity for v2 - NO maxCount enforced by structural shape; v1 multi:false documents the v1 cardinality)

Capability.comment: FROZEN (verbatim). Coarse access posture (read/write) the agent holds.

Tool.comment: FROZEN (verbatim). A tool the agent used or DECLARED (demand-signal).

Voice.comment: NET-NEW. An internal voice of an agent. BORROWS the agent's membrane; identified at the leaf (agt:voiceId EQUALS the mem:agentId string), owns no graph of its own. A Monovocal agent has exactly one (elided). Secession (voice->agent = 'grant a membrane') is admissible but UNIMPLEMENTED in v1. Dual-typed agt:Witness.

agt:voiceOf.source: Voice -> the agt:Agent whose membrane it borrows (I2/I4a: required, exactly one)

agt:voiceId.source: the leaf tag; EQUALS the mem:agentId string written on records this voice authored (the I2 join key)

Voice.subject_rule: <agentIRI>#voice:{voiceId} - voice IRI shape (spec §7-decision-5: mintVoiceUri unbuilt in v1)

Driver.comment: NET-NEW, THIN by design. An EXTERNAL steerer of an agent (a human or another agent at the wheel). Distinct from agt:Voice (who the agent IS). A pointer only; turn-taking / multi-driver authority is v2. Dual-typed prov:Agent.

Voicing.comment: NET-NEW enum-class. An enumerated mode on agt:Agent (owl:oneOf agt:Monovocal agt:Parliament). The agent is ALWAYS a parliament; voicing only says whether it has one seat or many - NOT two schemas. Registry-only (no rdf_types target -> no derived structural shape; the cardinality teeth live in the §3 sh:select I3 shapes).

Witness.comment: NET-NEW documentary glue. Anything whose facts are attributed, timestamped, defeasible testimony. Two scopes: Agent (OWNS a membrane) and Voice (BORROWS one). Registry-only superclass (no rdf_types target -> no structural shape; agt:Agent/agt:Voice carry it as an asserted upper type).

Faculty.comment: NET-NEW. A witness-relative capacity of an agent: Song, Memory, or Valuation. Binds a real L0 vocabulary + (when witness-scoped) a per-observer membrane. The three faculty INSTANCES (agt:Song / agt:Memory / agt:Valuation) are fixed members carrying agt:bindsRecordClass + agt:membranePattern + agt:witnessScoped. bindsRecordClass is rdfs:range rdfs:Class (multi) so the A-subset-B closure check is well-defined.

agt:bindsRecordClass.source: the L0 RDF class(es) this faculty's records carry (real Ground vocab: mem:MemoryRecord / mnemo:Song* / mnemo:BlockValuation); MULTI-VALUED; ranged rdfs:Class

agt:membranePattern.source: the named-graph template that is this faculty's membrane for a given observer

agt:witnessScoped.source: true iff the membrane forks per-observer (…:agent:{id}); false iff a commons (the Valuation gap, spec §6 ask #5). Valuation's witnessScoped = true is the per-observer salience read side which is on main.

ReadOperation.comment: NET-NEW. Attunement is a READ across the three faculties, NOT a fourth faculty. agt:Attunement a agt:ReadOperation readsAcross Song+Memory+Valuation (ops: context_bundle / surface). Registry-only (no rdf_types target -> no structural shape).

agt:readsAcross.source: ReadOperation -> the agt:Faculty(ies) it reads across

PoolingMode.comment: NET-NEW enum-class (owl:oneOf agt:Pooled agt:Differentiated). Pooled = faculty operates at the AGENT level (all voices share it); Differentiated = per VOICE. Registry-only (no rdf_types target -> no structural shape).

FacultyPooling.comment: NET-NEW. Reified (voice x faculty) -> pooling mode: the per-faculty 'share one Geist' knob. A multi-voice agent may pool Memory at agent level while differentiating Song per voice. Absence defaults to agt:Pooled for a monovocal agent.

Run.comment: NET-NEW (§WS1 relevel). One execution within an agt:Session (was the run-grain agt:Session). agt:realizedBy is the inverse reading of wf:Run wf:boundToAgent agt:Run; inference provider/model are the binding actually used for this run. Publication face mirrors the user:rdf serializer.

agt:inferenceProvider.source: the inference provider used for this run (serializer face)

agt:inferenceModel.source: the inference model used for this run (serializer face)

agt:supersedesLegacyRunSession.source: §WS1 migration bridge: the pre-relevel run-grain agt:Session this Run supersedes

comment: Agent Ontology v1 - the agent-as-subject, observer-relative (spec plans/ca1-agent-ontology-v1-20260623.md). A COMPOSITE Meaningful-Object vocab: it owl:imports mem: (the sophia-memory-core grammar) and references the mnemo: Song / BlockValuation projections BY RELATION (agt:bindsRecordClass), never re-vocab'ing them - build-time A subset-of runtime B. The 5 frozen classes (Agent/Session/Turn/Capability/Tool) are verbatim from choreograph agent-ontology.ts and MUST NOT be altered. The one-directional alias mem:observedBy rdfs:subPropertyOf agt:witnessedBy reads UP (L0's predicate is the subproperty of the agt: reading) and is DELIBERATELY UN-RANGED so it can NEVER re-type stored L0 mem:observedBy data as agt:Agent by entailment; that constraint lives only on the I1 SHACL shape. NEVER mint mnemo:/doc:/nfo: (materializer-co-managed). agt: subjects are URN-space. This is a VOCAB-PUBLICATION pack (served + queryable), not a record-materialization pack: it has no write_target, so generic ingest of agt: instances rides the user:rdf applier path (the spec's worked instances), while the membrane/leaf testimony is written by the existing L0 memory/song materializers under mem:/mnemo:.
description: The agent-as-subject: an agt:Agent IS a memory-witness that OWNS a perspective membrane (a named graph) - its facts are attributed, timestamped, defeasible testimony. Voices BORROW the membrane (leaf-attributed via mem:agentId); Drivers STEER it from outside. The three Geist faculties - Song (mnemo:Song*), Memory (mem:MemoryRecord), Valuation (mnemo:BlockValuation, care = its valence axis) - bind to real L0 names, with Attunement as a read-op across them. Monovocal is the proven degenerate parliament-of-one.
name: sophia-agent-core

mem:observedBy.comment: ONE-DIRECTIONAL, UN-RANGED. mem:observedBy rdfs:subPropertyOf agt:witnessedBy. The agt: reading of the L0 predicate; carries NO rdfs:range so an alias never rewrites stored L0 datatype-IRI objects into typed agt:Agent class members. The 'object is an agt:Agent' constraint is enforced per-membrane by the I1 SHACL shape, not by property entailment.
